source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-compcb-corner-algebra — Uniform compressed-corner algebra: there are universal C_ca < infinity and e_ca > 0 such that, whenever e=delta+epsilon <= e_ca and P is a nonvanishing delta-projection, S_P with the compressed product, inherited involution, and compressed unit u_P=Co_P(P) is an extended C_ca*e-C*-algebra.
